accepted = []

    async def assert_one_cycle_latency_no_stall(a, b):
        exp = uadd8_uadd8_to_u9(a, b)
        dut.out_ready.value = 1

        while True:
            await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
            dut.in_valid.value = 1
            dut.in_op_a.value = a
            dut.in_op_b.value = b
            await Timer(1, unit="ns")
            ir = int(dut.in_ready.value)
            ov_same = int(dut.out_valid.value)
            await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
            if int(dut.rst_n.value) == 1 and ir == 1:
                assert ov_same == 0, (
                    f"latency violation (early) a={a} b={b} expected_sum={exp} "
                    f"out_valid_seen_same_cycle={ov_same}"
                )
                dut.in_valid.value = 0
                break

        await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")
        ov_next = int(dut.out_valid.value)
        sum_next = int(dut.out_sum.value)
        assert ov_next == 1, (
            f"latency violation (missing t+1 valid) a={a} b={b} expected_sum={exp} "
            f"out_valid_t_plus_1={ov_next}"
        )
        assert sum_next == exp, (
            f"latency violation (wrong t+1 data) a={a} b={b} expected_sum={exp} "
            f"out_sum_t_plus_1={sum_next}"
        )
        await RisingEdge(dut.clk)

        await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")
        ov_late = int(dut.out_valid.value)
        assert ov_late == 0, (
            f"latency violation (late persistence) a={a} b={b} expected single transfer at t+1 "
            f"out_valid_t_plus_2={ov_late}"
        )
